title: The filter on a tier's Customers tab
stem: Which options should this filter offer?

options.t: Work orders, Part Sales and Both, as the PRD and the developers' plan say. Please also say whether "Work orders" means customers on the tier for work orders only, or every customer on the tier for work orders.
A "Sales Type" filter with "Work Orders and Part Sales" and "Work Orders only", as the design draws

context: The PRD lists "Work orders, Part Sales, Both". The design names the filter Sales Type with different options.
where: PRD Story 9 (a tier's Customers tab); developers' plan for Tiered Pricing, Phase 17; Tiered Pricing design canvas, picture 9.3
